title.narrative: Provision of emergency life-saving WASH assistance to the most vulnerable communities in Jowhar flagship pilot project to address the impact of deteriorating dry conditions

description.narrative: ltpgtThe 2024–2025 Multi-Sector Needs Assessment (MSNA) highlights severe WASH gaps across Somalia, with IDPs and vulnerable host communities in Jowhar District among the most affected. The assessment indicates that 26% of households rely on unsafe drinking water sources, while 69% of IDPs and 51% of host communities lack sufficient water for drinking, cooking, and washing. Alarmingly, 25% of IDPs depend on surface water, exposing communities to recurrent outbreaks of cholera, AWD, and diarrheal disease. Sanitationltspangt conditions remain critically inadequate. Fifty-eight percent of IDPs rely on shared latrines, many of which are poorly constructed and unsafe, while only 22% of households use pit latrines overall. These gaps disproportionately affect women, girls, older persons, and persons with disabilities, increasing health risks and exposure to protection concerns, including lack of privacy and GBV risks.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtCommunity-Engagement Findings: Participatory community engagement conducted in Jowhar IDP settlements and rural villages confirmed these assessment findings and further highlighted priority needs for:Reliable and safe water supply through boreholes and rehabilitated systems,Flood-resilient sanitation facilities with safety and lighting features, Improved hygiene practices and access to hygiene supplies, Community ownership and sustainability through local WASH committees, Communities emphasized the need for long-term, climate-resilient solutions rather than short-term emergency measures.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtIn response, KRDO proposes a lifesaving, integrated WASH intervention targeting 2,665 households (17,188 people) in Jowhar’s IDP settlements and rural villages. The project combines emergency response with resilience-building, guided by community-identified priorities.ltbrgtKey interventions include:ltbrgtWater supply: Hydrogeological surveys, borehole drilling, and rehabilitation of one water system with solar-powered pumping, installation of storage tanks, and extension of piped networks to communities, schools, and health facilities in Shiidle Bari and Bulo Waray.ltbrgtSustainability: Establishment and training of two gender-balanced Water Management Committees to support community ownership and OM.ltbrgtSanitation and environmental health: Construction of 120 emergency latrines (15% disability-friendly, all with solar lighting), distribution of 80 sanitation toolkits, and implementation of solid waste management campaigns.ltbrgtHygiene promotion and accountability: Distribution of 1,055 hygiene kits, hygiene promotion sessions, training on PSEA, and implementation of baseline, PDMs, and community feedback mechanisms. The response will be integrated with Health, Nutrition, Livelihoods, and Protection programs and coordinated with WASH Cluster partners to maximize impact. As a women-led national organization with strong local presence, KRDO is well positioned to deliver inclusive, protection-mainstreamed, and sustainable WASH services aligned with SHF and WASH Cluster priorities.ltbrgtCoordination and IntegrationltbrgtTo maximize impact, KRDO will integrate this WASH response with its ongoing Health, Nutrition, Livelihoods, and Protection programs, and coordinate closely with WASH Cluster partners including PAH, Alight, KAAH, and other actors operating in Jowhar. This integrated approach enhances efficiency, strengthens public health outcomes, and ensures comprehensive support to the most vulnerable households.ltbrgtOrganizational CapacityltbrgtKRDO is a nationally registered, women-led organization with a strong operational presence in Jowhar District, Hirshabelle State, and demonstrated experience implementing multi-sector humanitarian projects over the past year. Leveraging community trust and local expertise, KRDO is well positioned to deliver inclusive, accountable, and sustainable WASH services aligned with SHF and WASH Cluster priorities.ltbrgtlt/pgt
